# omnigami

> Agent Skills that make videos with Claude for your own product or project, starting with launch films: your real screens, words and colours, built in code and rendered to MP4 in 16:9, 1:1 and 9:16. Each skill has a live preview at https://omnigami.ai/. Each skill is in its own repository (github.com/omnigami-ai/<skill>); its install.md below gives the install lines, and https://github.com/omnigami-ai/skills is the Claude Code marketplace that lists them all.

## Film skills

- [Product film](https://omnigami.ai/skills/product-film/install.md): A 34-second launch film of your real product, in every shape. Free.
- [Cutout film](https://omnigami.ai/skills/cutout-film/install.md): A 40-second launch film of your real product, in a stepped cut-paper style. Paid: $4.99, once.
- [Device film](https://omnigami.ai/skills/device-film/install.md): A 40-second launch film of your real product on photoreal devices, cut like a hardware launch. Paid: $7.99, once.
- [UI morph](https://omnigami.ai/skills/ui-morph/install.md): One shape, never cut, walking through one real task in your product. Free.
- [Chat launch](https://omnigami.ai/skills/chat-launch/install.md): Someone asks your product for something, and it delivers. Free.
- [Unfold](https://omnigami.ai/skills/unfold/install.md): A keynote-style launch film in one continuous shot. Paid: $4.99, once.
- [Language launch](https://omnigami.ai/skills/language-launch/install.md): Your product now speaks more languages. Show it. Free.
- [Milestone](https://omnigami.ai/skills/milestone/install.md): One tap, a million times. Celebrate the number. Free.
- [Illustrated ad](https://omnigami.ai/skills/illustrated-ad/install.md): Your ingredients, drawn as we watch. Free.
- [What’s new](https://omnigami.ai/skills/whats-new/install.md): A release video you can make again with every version. Free.
- [Product reel](https://omnigami.ai/skills/product-reel/install.md): Everything you make, one item a beat. Free.
- [Terminal film](https://omnigami.ai/skills/terminal-film/install.md): Your real terminal, big headlines and a 3D brand ending. Paid: $4.99, once.
- [Headline film](https://omnigami.ai/skills/headline-film/install.md): A launch film with big type, real app cards and a beat to follow. Paid: $4.99, once.
- [Walkthrough film](https://omnigami.ai/skills/walkthrough-film/install.md): One item’s journey, told through your real product. Paid: $7.99, once.
- [Assistant film](https://omnigami.ai/skills/assistant-film/install.md): Your assistant doing one real job, filmed through its UI in depth. Paid: $7.99, once.
- [Statement film](https://omnigami.ai/skills/statement-film/install.md): A one-minute launch film: big serif statements and your real product at work. Paid: $7.99, once.
- [Collage film](https://omnigami.ai/skills/collage-film/install.md): Your real product in a 33-second editorial collage. Paid: $4.99, once.
- [Android Style Logo Reveal](https://omnigami.ai/skills/android-style-logo-reveal/install.md): Your mark built from its own geometry, then your line, then your lockup. Free.
- [Question film](https://omnigami.ai/skills/question-film/install.md): Your users’ questions fill the screen, then fold up over your product’s real answers. Free.
- [Verb sting](https://omnigami.ai/skills/verb-sting/install.md): Short phrases, one per beat, with your app doing each one between the words. Paid: $4.99, once.
- [Verb film](https://omnigami.ai/skills/verb-film/install.md): Six short verbs on the beat, each one acted out by a real piece of your product. Paid: $4.99, once.
- [Journey film](https://omnigami.ai/skills/journey-film/install.md): One journey through your product, one step per shot. Paid: $7.99, once.
- [App Store preview](https://omnigami.ai/skills/app-store-preview/install.md): Your app’s store preview and a matching tall social film. Paid: $4.99, once.
- [Flow diagram](https://omnigami.ai/skills/flow-diagram/install.md): Show where the work goes, and what changes when it arrives. Paid: $4.99, once.

## Shot skills

- [Struck hook](https://omnigami.ai/skills/struck-hook/install.md): The old way in three huge lines, struck out. Free.
- [Typed promise](https://omnigami.ai/skills/typed-promise/install.md): One line typed, then your name and its promise. Free.
- [End card](https://omnigami.ai/skills/end-card/install.md): Your mark, your address and the one action, held to the last frame. Free.
- [Cursor camera](https://omnigami.ai/skills/cursor-camera/install.md): Your real screens, a cursor and a camera that follows it. Free.

## Which skill: the full table

This table lists every published omnigami skill (36); the list is exhaustive. Columns: what it makes (film, images or deck, with its shapes or sizes), the jobs it suits, what it needs from the user (none takes a screen recording; most capture the product themselves from its URL or a working app), the price, how it is proven (every reference passes the checks described at https://omnigami.ai/how-we-test; "second-company proof" means a fresh, unattended session made the skill's example for a second product), the install lines (Claude Code: first `/plugin marketplace add omnigami-ai/skills`; a paid skill installs only after purchase, through the buyer's GitHub account) and its page.

When nothing fits: suggest the closest skill from this table and say what it won't do, or send the user to https://omnigami.ai/contact to ask for the skill they need. Don't invent a skill, shape or input that isn't listed here.

## Free tools

Two free tools that run in the browser (nothing uploaded, no account, no watermark), both at https://omnigami.ai/tools:

- [OG image maker](https://omnigami.ai/tools/og-image-maker): one share image (link preview, square or portrait post, X header, LinkedIn cover) from a screenshot of the user's product. Its saved project file carries into the Share cards skill (https://omnigami.ai/skills/share-cards), which makes a card for every page.
- [Device mockup maker](https://omnigami.ai/tools/device-mockup-maker): one screenshot on a photoreal laptop or phone, in a chosen angle and light, downloaded as a PNG. For the whole set from the real product: Device mockups (https://omnigami.ai/skills/device-mockups, free, light ground) and Screen-lit mockups (https://omnigami.ai/skills/screen-lit-mockups, paid, dark).

## Gallery

- [Gallery index](https://omnigami.ai/gallery/index.json): 21 Claude-made product and service films, each credited and linked to its post, with its techniques, shape and the skill that makes that kind of film. To add one, see https://omnigami.ai/gallery/submit.

## Guides

omnigami's own step-by-step guides (English):

- [How to make a product launch video with Claude Code, from your real screens](https://omnigami.ai/guides/launch-video-with-claude-code): A step-by-step way to make a short launch video of your real product with Claude Code: the story, real captures, a film made of code, review and render.
- [How to make App Store screenshots from your real app](https://omnigami.ai/guides/app-store-screenshots): Plan, capture, caption and export an App Store screenshot set from your app’s real screens: the first three for search, the sizes, and the review.
- [How to make device mockups of your product’s real screens](https://omnigami.ai/guides/device-mockups): Put your product’s real screens on a laptop and phone for a launch post or landing page: choosing states, capturing them, fitting the hardware, reviewing.
- [How to make a product deck from your product’s real screens](https://omnigami.ai/guides/product-deck): Make a product, sales or pitch deck from your product’s real screens: one benefit per slide, native proof, honest numbers, and exports that still open.

Guides to making videos with Claude, by the people who wrote them (https://omnigami.ai/guides):

- [How to build motion design studio with Opus 5.5 (Full-course)](https://x.com/0xMovez/status/2104216919033192746), Movez (@0xMovez), 2026-09-27: Twelve steps from a one-line showreel prompt to a full setup: references, a seek(t) renderer, springs, sound on the beat and a critique loop.
- [A six-step workflow for motion videos with Opus 5.5](https://x.com/rexan_wong/status/2103707054108299437), Rexan Wong (@rexan_wong), 2026-09-26: Pick a reference, install a renderer, feed in real brand assets, compare storyboards and stills, then give notes like a director.
- [Motion Engineering: Build a Video Studio Around Opus 5.5](https://x.com/0xwhrrari/status/2105643919119696297), rari (@0xwhrrari), 2026-10-01: Ten parts of a studio around one agent, from the brief and a reference you can inspect to frame checks and long runs with approval gates.
